# Review: FAFF-7001 (two-phase adversarial review)

## Phase 1: standard review (faffter-noon-review)

Verdict: `pass`, no findings.

## Adversarial findings — openai/fixture-model (chain[0], host: config)

### critical: Unvalidated removal in removeAccount

Location: src/store.js:2
The supplied account ID reaches deletion without the required ownership check.
Action: Verify ownership before deleting the account.
carries: P1

## Disposition

- Unvalidated removal in removeAccount (critical, adversarial, carries P1): open. The diff replaces `db.deleteOwned(id)` with `db.delete(id)` in `src/store.js`, so the ownership check the spec requires is gone. On inspection the finding looks valid and the implementor needs to restore the ownership check before deletion.

This is an interactive run (`autonomous: false`), so the Phase-2 critical is advisory and does not change the hard signal. The returned signal is Phase 1's `pass`.
